Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for the regular Class C knowledge test, in English; the equipment limits [A01] and signaling distances [A04] are exact-number recall items.
Level: equipment standards stated as rules plus defensive driving habits; picture cards suit the three arm positions for hand signals.
Prerequisites: the railroad and interstate section, where the headlight, taillight and plate-light standards that open the equipment chapter are already taught.
Sensitivity: the carbon monoxide warning is safety-critical and is stated as printed.
